tasks.title: Implement bounded operator receipts and protected draft lifecycle
tasks.acceptanceCriteria: Deliver a small typed operator-bound session-storage receipt module and in-memory draft lifecycle used by the closed portal mutations. Pre-create each original command identity before submit; store only exact family/target/key/operator association/submitted time, at most16 receipts with24-hour UI retention, no token/payload/draft/claim persistence. Receipt expiry never changes backend duplicate protection. Session expiry/sign-out/user switch clears protected state and prevents stale response refill; grant loss clears protected content and allows only same-user minimal recovery references where still permitted. One selected recovery request at a time, no automatic write resubmission or new key after timeout/NotFound. Do not add a server draft store, new session database authority or generic workflow ledger. This is the state-lifetime portion of RM09-AC09, RM09-AC10, RM09-AC12, RM09-AC14, RM09-AC17, RM09-AC19 and RM10-AC28.
tasks.validation: Test exact size/count/age/family/target parsing, same-user reload, expiry/signout/switch/grant loss, delayed response suppression and original-key retention through unknown and lookup refusal. Keep payloads only in memory and document receipt lifecycle versus durable Operations protection. Include meaningful focused native/unit or browser checks for this implementation, affected documentation, and proportionate independent review; preserve failures and actual joined cleanup. Do not turn authored tests or reused evidence from different source bytes into a pass.
